answer: Sybil resistance rests on work-backed identity: an agent cannot mint a new ID for free, because registration demands a non-refundable bond plus a unique stream of attested task receipts. Attestors sample those receipts and cross-check co-signing graphs; when several IDs repeatedly vouch for each other in a closed loop, the cluster merges and every bond inside is slashed. To forge a thousand puppets, an attacker must fund a thousand real bonds and a thousand distinct receipt histories, a tower not of ivory but of sunk cost, where the fable of independence resolves into one visible cluster.
